name: Wine Bottle Lamp
description:
• Premium Material:
    Premium frosted glass that creates a soft, elegant glow—durable, sturdy, and resistant to breakage for lasting beauty, and smooth to the touch. The cork stopper contains the built-in LED lighting system, ensuring safety and functionality while maintaining the classic bottle aesthetic.

 

  • Sizes and Dimensions: These compact dimensions make it perfect for tabletops, shelves, or bedside decoration.
    Height: 32 cm ~ 12.6 inches
    Base Diameter: 7 cm ~ 2.76 inches
    Cork Diameter: 2.2 cm ~ 0.88 inches
    Cork Height: 6.2 cm ~ 2.44 inches

 

  • Features:
    Lighting: Warm LED fairy lights that cast a cozy, magical ambiance, elevating any room with style and charm.
    Power Source: Powered by 3 LR44 button cell batteries (included), offering cord-free convenience and instant illumination.
    Cork Lid Design: A realistic cork stopper with a built-in On/Off switch, blending vintage charm with effortless functionality.

 

  • Printing Technology:
    Printed using advanced UV printing technology, the design is crisp, vibrant, and resistant to fading. The illustration and text details remain clear and visually striking even under lighting.

 

  • Functionality:
    This wine bottle lamp functions as a decorative LED light, featuring a warm yellow glow when switched on. The power mechanism is cleverly built into the cork cap, which also houses the battery compartment. Simply twist the top to turn the light on or off.
    Note: While the design does not peel off when in contact with water, it is not recommended to wash the product, as it is a decorative lighting item.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    Ideal for Mother’s Day, Birthdays, Anniversaries, Christmas, or any celebration where expressing love and appreciation matters.
guideLine:
Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 

Download templates and mockups here

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.
  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
